visualLanguage: design_system/public/PUBLIC_UI.md. No mockup ever existed for the subdivisions index; this file exists so the class carries a taste receipt (SITE-52, 2026-09-09) and so ci:mockup-parity notices if the index loses a section.
competitiveTarget: A portal's subdivision list: an alphabet of links with no count and no photo. We publish the live single-family count per plat drawn as a bar on one shared scale, the median list price, a verified plat photo or the glyph on every row, and the A to Z browser for every recorded plat under it.
note: Created 2026-09-09 for SITE-52 (V3Ledger: visible encode, all-or-none media, hover reveal, no repeated when). The subdivisions index is the second Ledger-led class the node names beside the cities index; it had no parity.json and no tasteReview before this, so the receipt below is the class's FIRST mark.
sectionOrder: V3SectionTracker + MetadataBlock -- BreadcrumbList and the CollectionPage/ItemList JSON-LD (not sections)
V3Ledger #featured-plats -- the H1, the caption (count, and what a bar is), every registry plat with a live count as a bar on the list's shared scale, a photo or the monogram, the median list price

tasteReview.evaluator: separate claude-sonnet-5 evaluator agent, SITE-52, session 019RdEm6 — the table instrument (first viewport at 1440x900 and 375x812, scripts/take-route-shots.mjs, scale 1, palette-quantized) on the lane's own dev server (localhost:3198) for /subdivisions; three independent scorings of one capture run, the median; no page code read, no live page opened. The class had no table row and no receipt: this is its first mark. Rounds this lane ran before recording: cold (36: 36·37·33, the wash glyph read as an unstyled placeholder), after the navy monogram (44: 44·48·41, the phone eyebrow repeated the row's sentence), and this one after the row dropped its when and the caption says what a bar is. The builder ran on a different model from the evaluator on every round.
tasteReview.beats: Redfin's neighborhood-directory pages: this page wins on restraint, one plain descriptive sentence per row instead of a stat-badge cluster, hairline dividers instead of card shadows, and an actual quantity bar instead of decorative icons.
tasteReview.dullest: The row list past the first two entries: every row repeats the identical photo/title/description/bar/count shape with no variation besides one navy bar marking the current max, giving a reader no reason to keep scrolling rather than skim for their own subdivision's name.
tasteReview.verdict: The palette and type discipline are right; this reads as Ryan Realty from a single cropped row, and the navy accent picking out the top subdivision is a genuinely smart touch. But underneath that it is one long alphabetically sorted list wearing a bar chart as a costume: the bars do not rank anything, nothing on the page rewards a hover, and there is no source line in the fold on figures the brand's own rules treat as load-bearing. Sort it by the number it is showing, give the list something to click, and cite the data in the fold.

defects.finding: The list is sorted alphabetically even though the subhead says each bar encodes share of the largest live count; the counts jump non-monotonically down the page (5, 12, 14, 2, 7, 4), so the bar lengths never read as a ranking.
defects.fix: Sort rows by for-sale count descending by default, or add a sort toggle, so bar length reads as a comparison the reader can use.

defects.finding: No source trace, as-of date, or freshness label appears near the median list prices or for-sale counts in the fold; nothing in the first viewport tells the reader whether this is live MLS data or a cached snapshot (the ledger's source line sits under the list, below the fold).
defects.fix: Add an 'Updated <date> · MLS' line under the caption, matching the citation discipline the site uses elsewhere.

defects.finding: Neither shot shows any sign that a row, bar, or thumbnail responds to hover or tap with more data; the reveal V3Ledger gained on the city index is not wired here because no per-plat Market Truth overlay exists.
defects.primitive: components/site/v3/V3Ledger.tsx (reveal not wired on this route)
defects.fix: Give the row a hover/hold reveal (a year of closes, the community's verdict) once a per-plat series is published.

defects.section: #featured-plats thumbnails (7th Mtn Golf Village, Glaze Meadow Homesite Section)
defects.finding: Rows without a photo fall back to a solid navy square with a single cream initial, which sits visually heavier and flatter than the photographic thumbnails on neighboring rows.
defects.fix: A lighter treatment (navy-on-cream outline, or a thin Central Oregon line mark) so it reads as an intentional variant, not a missing-image placeholder; or a verified photo for every plat.

defects.finding: At 375 the two-line title and three-line description run well past the thumbnail's height, leaving empty cream beside the small square photo before the bar and count appear.
defects.fix: Grow the thumbnail to the row's text height, or balance a shorter element beside long text so every row keeps one silhouette.

contentFloor.note: No-regression floor (ci:route-content-floor). A build under any number here fails before the evaluator runs. Lower a number only by hand, in the same commit, with the reason.
